items.title: Is Mondelez (MDLZ) Quietly Rewiring Its Supply Chain Strategy Through Canadian Farms And Toblerone?
items.summary: Mondelez International recently backed Canadian agriculture by committing capital to Area One Farms Fund V and expanded its premium chocolate lineup with the global launch of Toblerone Diamond Truffles with Biscoff. Together, these moves highlight how Mondelez is tying product innovation to supply chain resilience and regenerative farming, linking indulgent snacking with longer-term ingredient security. items.title: Should You Buy PepsiCo Stock Because Its International Business Keeps Accelerating?
items.summary: PepsiCo (PEP) stock traded at $129.75 on September 18, the lowest price of its past 52 weeks. The worry is North America, where sales of snacks and drinks have disappointed. Yet the part of PepsiCo that sells outside the U.S. is growing faster and earning more on each sale. The share price appears to give that part little credit.
